blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `updateProductOptionValuesOnProduct` method. This belongs to the Product Module.
You should only use this methods when implementing complex customizations. For common cases, check out [available workflows instead](/medusa-workflows-reference).
This method updates product option values linked to a product option for a product.

```ts
await productModuleService.updateProductOptionValuesOnProduct({
  product_id: "prod_123",
  product_option_id: "opt_123",
  add: ["optval_1", { value: "M" }],
  remove: ["optval_2"],
})
```
